g.text: Battery -> Feather JST. ANO -> Feather STEMMA QT. No new charger or power rail.

g.desc: Battery -> Feather JST. ANO -> Feather STEMMA QT. No new charger or power rail.

g.text: Display VIN -> Feather 3V3. Display 3Vo stays disconnected.

g.desc: Display VIN -> Feather 3V3. Display 3Vo stays disconnected.

g.text: SCK = GPIO14, MOSI = GPIO27 (NOT the pins labeled SCK/MO on Feather).

g.desc: SCK = GPIO14, MOSI = GPIO27 (NOT the pins labeled SCK/MO on Feather).

g.text: TFT RST = GPIO32 (NOT Feather RESET). P11 is optional; cable-only firmware still wakes by Reset.
